Name: Zawarudo - Time Stop Ability
Author: HoangTuDaa18
Description:
[quote][center][color=#ffff00][size=5][font=Comic Sans MS]About this mod[/font][/size][/color][/center]
[/quote][b][color=#ffff00]ZA WARUDO![/color][/b]
Ever wanted to stop time in Stardew Valley?
[color=#ffff00]ZAWARUDO[/color] brings the power of time manipulation to your farm life! Activate your ability to freeze the world around you while remaining free to move, explore, and fight.
When activated, a dramatic shockwave spreads from your character as the screen gradually fades into grayscale. After a 3-second activation sequence, time stops for 7 seconds.
The world stands still. You don't.
This mod is designed purely for fun and experimentation, offering a completely different way to experience Stardew Valley And I’m a fan of JoJo.
[img width=511]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/55761/55761-1795092160-1397859778.gif[/img]
[quote][center][color=#ffff00][size=5][font=Comic Sans MS]Features[/font][/size][/color][/center]
[/quote][list]
[*][b]Time Stop:[/b] Freeze the world for 7 seconds while retaining control of your character.[/*]
[*][b]Activation Shockwave:[/b] A visual shockwave expands outward from your character during the 3-second activation sequence.[/*]
[*][b]Grayscale Screen Effect:[/b] The screen gradually fades into a dark grayscale appearance.[/*]
[*][b]Frozen NPCs:[/b] NPCs stop moving and cannot be interacted with during Time Stop.[/*]
[*][b]Frozen Monsters:[/b] Monsters stop moving and attacking, allowing you to fight them freely.[/*]
[*][b]Frozen World:[/b] Environmental animations and creatures are intended to stop moving along with the world.[/*]
[*][b]Silent World:[/b] Temporarily mutes the game's background music, sound effects, ambient sounds, and footsteps while preserving ZAWARUDO's own sound effects.[/*]
[*][b]Cooldown System:[/b] Time Stop has a 45-second cooldown after activation.[/*]
[*][b]GMCM Support:[/b] Customize the activation key and selected visual/audio settings through Generic Mod Config Menu (optional dependency).[/*]
[/list][img width=503]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/55761/55761-1795092185-280891649.gif[/img]
[quote][center][color=#ffff00][size=5][font=Comic Sans MS]Important Notice & Compatibility [/font][/size][/color][/center]
[/quote][b]This is a cheat mod.[/b]
Let's be honest: stopping time while freely moving and attacking enemies is obviously not part of Stardew Valley's intended balance.
ZAWARUDO is created purely for entertainment. It is not designed to provide a balanced gameplay experience or preserve the original difficulty.
Please consider this before installing.
[b]Compatibility Warning[/b]
This is an early release, and compatibility with other mods is not guaranteed.
Mods that modify NPC behavior, monster AI, location updates, environmental animations, or other world simulation systems may conflict with ZAWARUDO or cause certain entities and animations to behave unexpectedly.
Some custom animations or effects from other mods may continue playing during Time Stop.
If you encounter any issues, please report them with your SMAPI log and a description of the affected mod or feature.
Thank you for trying ZAWARUDO!
